text:
Alice Park: Heads-up — Lithos Labs NDA is signed. They’ll ship us a 4-node dev rack next Wed. Need to lock down EAP scope: benchmarks, telemetry, and joint announce timeline. @Mohit Singh can you own bench plan? :eyes:
Mohit Singh: Got it — will draft workloads. Plan to run perf (latency/throughput), memory, and power runs. Do we want our internal microbench harness or run their distro?
Alice Park: Use our harness (rci) for apples-to-apples. We'll also run their vendor BSP for comparison. Need telemetry hooks wired to /telemetry/lithos-eap.
Natalie Gomez: Product side — customer-facing milestones? We should avoid public mention until joint PR. Proposed EAP window: 4 weeks with a week of integration + 3 weeks of iterative tuning. OK? :+1:
Evan (Partner Eng): I'll coordinate access and set up a jump host. Also request their perf counters and hw counters list. Lithos asked for 2 sample prompts to reproduce perf; I'll share shortly.
Mohit Singh: Draft bench plan snippet:
```sh
rci run-bench --target lithos --model redwood-ops-v2 --seq 2048 --concurrency 8 --trace /tmp/lithos-trace
```
Will add power profiling steps.
qa-bot: Reminder: please add the test vectors to /shared/bench/lithos/vectors before starting. Failure to include will auto-skip telemetry.
Alice Park: Action items: @Mohit -> bench plan + scripts by Mon EOD; @Evan -> jump host + vendor counters by Tue; @Natalie -> finalize EAP calendar + PR blackout window; @QA -> prep vectors. Also decide success criteria: target 95th latency < 120ms and 99th < 250ms for 2k tokens? Thoughts?
Mohit Singh: 95th@120ms is aggressive but plausible with quantized model. We'll record baseline and optimized runs.
Natalie Gomez: Agree on conservative threshold: initial success = 95th < 180ms, target for "green" is 120ms. We'll call out fallback model variants in announcement.
Evan (Partner Eng): Lithos requested a slack channel with their engs. I'll create invite after NDA cleared. Also they want a brief runbook template — I'll drop a skeleton in the repo.
Alice Park: Great. I'll update the partner tracking doc and add these as tasks. Ping if blockers. Thanks everyone :party:
